variant.title: Dutch Whispers Sudoku
variant.description: Every adjacent pair on a whisper line differs by at least four.
rule.dutch_whispers: Adjacent digits on a whisper line must differ by at least 4.
rule_guide.title: Dutch Whispers Sudoku
rule_guide.item_1: Digits on a whisper line are orthogonally connected.
rule_guide.item_2: Every adjacent pair on the line differs by at least four.
rule_guide.item_3: A whisper line may turn at an orthogonal corner.
